primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The percentage of participants achieving viGA-AD "success" is presented with multiple imputation of missing observations. viGA-AD "success" is defined as a viGA-AD score of 'clear' or 'almost clear' PLUS a 2-grade improvement from Baseline. The viGA-AD is a static evaluation of qualitative overall AD severity. This global assessment scale is an ordinal scale with five severity grades (reported only in integers of 0 to 4 where 0 is clear), with higher scores indicative of greater symptom severity.
